eng.definition: a seemingly absurd or self-contradictory statement or proposition that when investigated or explained may prove to be well founded or true
examples: It's a curious paradox that drinking a lot of water can often make you feel thirsty.
The paradox is that the region's most dynamic economies have the most primitive financial systems.
In a paradox, he has discovered that stepping back from his job has increased the rewards he gleans from it.
